decks.notes: The deck revolves around filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Striped Riverwinder and Curator of Mysteries using cycle cards and cascade spells. By casting Living End, all creatures in the graveyard are brought back into play, overwhelming the opponent with a sudden surge of creatures. The key strategy is to efficiently cycle through the deck while controlling the board with disruption spells like Force of Negation, allowing for a massive swing in tempo with the Living End combo. The deck aims to quickly overpower the opponent before they have a chance to establish a strong board presence.

The main theme of this Merfolk Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of disruptive and evasive Merfolk creatures. The deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence with cards like Lord of Atlantis, Master of the Pearl Trident, and Silvergill Adept, while utilizing spells like Merfolk Trickster and Subtlety to control the opponent's board. The inclusion of Aether Vial allows for creatures to be put into play at instant speed, giving the deck flexibility and unpredictability in combat. The deck's mana base is optimized for casting Merfolk creatures efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly swarm the board with powerful Merfolk creatures, using cards like Lord of Atlantis, Master of the Pearl Trident, and Merfolk Trickster to boost their abilities. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Mistcaller and Force of Negation to control the opponent's plays. With a strong mana base and Aether Vial for added flexibility, the deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while steadily building a threatening board presence to overwhelm them.

The main concept of this Modern Combo - Hammer Time deck is to quickly assemble a powerful equipment combo using cards like Puresteel Paladin, Stoneforge Mystic, and Colossus Hammer, along with Sigarda's Aid and Giver of Runes for protection. By equipping creatures with powerful equipment like Kaldra Compleat and Nettlecyst, the deck aims to deal massive damage to opponents in a short amount of time, utilizing cards like Esper Sentinel and Spell Pierce to control the game and disrupt opponents' strategies. With Urza's Saga providing additional utility and card advantage, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and deadly combo.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and Wrenn and Six, and versatile creatures like Solitude and Endurance. It also aims to generate card advantage and fix its mana base efficiently with cards like Oath of Nissa and Risen Reef. The inclusion of powerful threats like Omnath and Elesh Norn allows the deck to quickly close out games once it has established control. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's five-color control strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Cascade mechanic to generate value and overwhelm opponents with powerful spells for free. By casting cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, the player can cascade into spells like Crashing Footfalls and Dead / Gone to create a board presence quickly and efficiently. The addition of cards like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower provide additional threats and disruption, while cards like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute help protect the player's game plan. The deck aims to be aggressive and proactive, while maintaining control over the game through Cascade triggers.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with Cascade to put pressure on the opponent, utilizing cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to trigger Cascade effects. The goal is to consistently bring out powerful creatures like Crashing Footfalls and Murktide Regent while disrupting the opponent with counterspells like Force of Negation. The deck also includes versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Fiery Islet to maintain tempo and control the battlefield. By overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruptive abilities, the deck aims to secure a swift victory in Modern 1 vs 1 matches.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and win the game quickly through a powerful combo. It also employs cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to control the board and protect the combo pieces. The deck aims to be creative in its approach to winning games, utilizing cards that can generate value and disrupt opponents while setting up for the explosive combo finish.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card advantage. The Elemental creatures in the deck provide value when they enter the battlefield and work well with the various spells and abilities. The companion, Keruga, allows for card draw while playing higher-cost spells. The mana base is well-balanced to support the various color requirements of the deck. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing a board presence and ultimately winning through incremental advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and disruptive spells to apply early pressure on the opponent. It combines efficient removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt with hand disruption in the form of Thoughtseize to control the opponent's resources. Seasoned Pyromancer and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provide card advantage while also presenting threats on the board. The inclusion of Dauthi Voidwalker and Grief disrupt the opponent's game plan by targeting their key cards. Additionally, the deck has some graveyard recursion and a small amount of card draw to maintain its momentum throughout the game.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity and Transmogrify to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and create game-ending combos. Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce provide control elements to protect the combo pieces, while Wrenn and Six provide card advantage and mana fixing. The deck also includes a variety of utility lands like Dwarven Mine and Ketria Triome to ensure consistent mana base. The overall strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while assembling the combo pieces to quickly close out the game.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively control the board using inexpensive spells and efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with countermagic and removal spells while also generating card advantage through cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. By applying pressure early on and maintaining control of the board, the deck seeks to finish the game before the opponent can stabilize and mount a comeback.

This deck focuses on casting cheap or free spells to quickly overwhelm your opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful cascade effects. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent, Violent Outburst, and Crashing Footfalls, you can flood the board with threats while disrupting your opponent's game plan. The inclusion of versatile spells like Dead / Gone and Force of Negation help you control the battlefield and protect your own creatures, while cards like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower provide additional pressure and versatility. With careful timing and sequencing, you can quickly close out games before your opponent has a chance to respond.

This deck focuses on quickly casting cascade spells to overwhelm the opponent with multiple threats on the battlefield. By utilizing cascade cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent, the deck is able to consistently put pressure on the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation. The deck also includes versatile spells like Dead / Gone and Fire / Ice to handle a variety of threats. Overall, this deck aims to play aggressively and efficiently to secure a quick victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing powerful early game threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure. The deck also includes disruption like Thoughtseize and Terminate to control the board and keep the opponent on their back foot. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Kolaghan's Command for card advantage and utility. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game using counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler. The goal is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, and then win the game by playing Scapeshift to fetch Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and deal massive damage to the opponent. Cards like Bring to Light and Wrenn and Six help with card advantage and versatility. The deck also includes powerful multicolor cards like Omnath, Locus of Creation to further dominate the game.
